policy: Every provider capability must receive an explicit Market Mode disposition before G3 and be revalidated at G7/G10. Provider count never changes Market Modes by itself; only canonical, rights-cleared, freshness-qualified and independently useful evidence may influence a mode.

controls.routing: All provider evidence enters through the canonical Smart Provider Router with Preferred vs Serving truth, budget/backpressure, cache, provenance, freshness and source-disagreement handling.
controls.adaptiveBehavior: The router may learn provider usefulness by dataset/session/regime, but policy changes remain proposals until validated and approved.
controls.deterministicBoundary: LLMs may extract, compare, detect contradictions, synthesize and explain. Deterministic/statistical code owns price truth, numeric Market Mode calculation, calibration and promotion evidence.
controls.productionInfluence: NOT_IMPLEMENTED, SHADOW and VALIDATED capabilities have no production Market Mode influence. APPROVED/PRODUCTION influence must be versioned, reversible and evidence-backed.
controls.failureSemantics: Missing, stale, contradictory, rights-unknown or low-confidence evidence degrades, abstains or remains contextual; it never manufactures a stronger mode.
controls.surface: Show concise mode, confidence, freshness, drivers, contradictions and material changes. Provider plumbing remains privileged Maintenance diagnostics.

assessments.canonicalOwner: Smart Provider Router -> canonical quote/liquidity state
assessments.evidencePolicy: Current provider timestamp, session/feed truth and liquidity provenance are mandatory.
assessments.acceptance: Session, entitlement, fallback, stale-data and source-disagreement fixtures preserve truthful modes.

assessments.canonicalOwner: Smart Provider Router -> canonical adjusted history
assessments.evidencePolicy: Adjustment, completeness, bar timestamp and symbol-lifecycle truth are required.
assessments.acceptance: Canonical history equivalence and fallback tests prevent provider-specific formula drift.

assessments.evidencePolicy: OPRA vs indicative state and entitlement must be explicit; unavailable options add no penalty.
assessments.acceptance: Options context cannot independently control a Market Mode or protected desk formula.

assessments.canonicalOwner: Smart Provider Router -> canonical quote state
assessments.evidencePolicy: Fresh provider time, session truth, deduplication and source reconciliation are mandatory.
assessments.acceptance: Stream/recovery transitions preserve Preferred vs Serving truth and deterministic equivalence.

assessments.evidencePolicy: Materiality, event time, symbol mapping and independence from syndicated copies are required.
assessments.acceptance: Context may explain or degrade confidence but cannot independently set a Market Mode.

assessments.canonicalOwner: Smart Provider Router -> canonical quote state
assessments.evidencePolicy: Recovery evidence must satisfy the same timestamp, session and freshness contracts as the preferred route.
assessments.acceptance: Fallback never overwrites fresher preferred evidence or changes formula semantics.

assessments.canonicalOwner: Smart Provider Router -> VIX special store / canonical history
assessments.evidencePolicy: Index-vs-equity semantics, delay, adjustment and canonical source labels are mandatory.
assessments.acceptance: Dedicated VIX and historical recovery fixtures preserve horizon behavior.

assessments.canonicalOwner: Smart Provider Router -> canonical recovery state
assessments.evidencePolicy: Recovery-only provenance, delay and stale-state semantics are mandatory.
assessments.acceptance: Recovery is never presented as preferred live truth and cannot inflate confidence.

assessments.evidencePolicy: Official/delayed timing must be explicit and must not be labeled live.
assessments.acceptance: Delayed-close evidence cannot satisfy an intraday-current requirement.

assessments.evidencePolicy: Freshness, symbol mapping, materiality and syndicated-evidence deduplication are required.
assessments.acceptance: Fallback news explains material risk but cannot independently determine a mode.

assessments.evidencePolicy: Release cadence and slow-moving macro timestamps must be interpreted by horizon rather than treated as live ticks.
assessments.acceptance: Macro influence is horizon-aware, freshness-aware and cannot manufacture intraday precision.

assessments.evidencePolicy: Official release timestamps and actuals are required; consensus is never invented.
assessments.acceptance: Release context may change risk/confidence but cannot silently reweight formulas.

assessments.evidencePolicy: Release cadence, energy relevance and sector materiality are required.
assessments.acceptance: Energy actuals remain contextual unless separately validated for a versioned mode input.

assessments.evidencePolicy: Filing period, amendment and company mapping are mandatory.
assessments.acceptance: Company fundamentals cannot independently control a broad-market mode.

assessments.evidencePolicy: Direct filing source, form meaning, filing time and amendment lineage are mandatory.
assessments.acceptance: Filing context may explain risk but does not silently alter protected mode or desk formulas.

assessments.canonicalOwner: Smart Provider Router -> Smart-Money / Research evidence
assessments.evidencePolicy: Disclosure lag, transaction/report dates, actor/security mapping, independence and rights must be explicit.
assessments.acceptance: Never treated as live market truth or an independent Day/market-wide mode driver.

assessments.canonicalOwner: SEC Intelligence with direct SEC EDGAR canonical truth
assessments.evidencePolicy: Direct SEC reconciliation, transaction-code semantics, filing/transaction dates and actor mapping are mandatory.
assessments.acceptance: Enrichment cannot override direct SEC truth or independently determine a Market Mode.

assessments.canonicalOwner: Smart Provider Router -> canonical adjusted history
assessments.evidencePolicy: Coverage, timestamps, adjustment policy, corporate-action lineage, disagreement and rights must pass SHADOW comparison.
assessments.acceptance: No production influence until deterministic equivalence, history-quality and rollback evidence are approved.

assessments.evidencePolicy: Action type, effective/process dates, ratios, symbol lineage, source disagreement and rights are mandatory.
assessments.acceptance: May correct evidence lineage after validation; never silently rewrites historical outcomes or modes.

assessments.canonicalOwner: Reliable Actionable Universe / canonical symbol classification
assessments.evidencePolicy: U.S.-listing eligibility, ticker/security identity, classification provenance and symbol lifecycle are mandatory.
assessments.acceptance: Classification changes require reconciliation and cannot silently remap historical evidence.

assessments.evidencePolicy: Universe, ranking window, timestamp, duplicates and provider provenance must be explicit.
assessments.acceptance: Never becomes a Market Mode input or a separate scanner/ranking owner.

assessments.evidencePolicy: AI-use, commercial, redistribution and persistence rights must be explicitly approved before egress.
assessments.acceptance: No Market Mode or AI consumption while rights are unknown or before separate SHADOW validation.
